    throws LLMFixException {

    String content = Optional.ofNullable(response)
        .map(ChatCompletionResponse::getChoices)
        .filter(choices -> !choices.isEmpty())
        .map(List::getFirst)

        });

    int thinkEndIndex = content.indexOf(THINK_BLOCK);
    if (thinkEndIndex >= 0) {
        return content.substring(thinkEndIndex + THINK_BLOCK.length()).trim();
    }

    return content;
}

{"filePath": "/app/code/CodeBenchRepos/implements/nbi/src/main/resources/mybatis/zenith/CapacityDBMapper.xml", "oldString": "        SELECT RANNE.NE_ID     as neId,
                CELLS.NODEBID AS gNodeBId,
                CELLS.CELLID   AS cellId,
                CASE
                    WHEN RANNE.SUBSCRIBESTATUS != 1 THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.nosubscribe'
                    WHEN RANNE.NE_ID IS NULL THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.noActive'
                    ELSE ''
                    END         AS remark
        FROM  T_MBB_RANNE_EXT RANNE

                CELLS.NODEBID AS gNodeBId,
                CELLS.CELLID   AS cellId,
                CASE
                    WHEN RANNE.SUBSCRIBESTATUS != 1 THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.nosubscribe'
                    WHEN RANNE.NE_ID IS NULL THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.noActive'
                    ELSE ''
                    END         AS remark
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_CELL CELL

{"filePath": "/app/code/CodeBenchRepos/implements/nbi/src/main/resources/mybatis/zenith/CapacityDBMapper.xml", "oldString": "        SELECT RANNE.NE_ID     as neId,
                CELLS.NODEBID AS gNodeBId,
                CELLS.CELLID   AS cellId,
                CASE
                    WHEN RANNE.SUBSCRIBESTATUS != 1 THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.nosubscribe'
                    WHEN RANNE.NE_ID IS NULL THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.noActive'
                    ELSE ''
                    END         AS remark
        FROM  T_MBB_RANNE_EXT RANNE
                 LEFT JOIN T_DTHR_CELL CELLS ON CELLS.NODEBID = RANNE.LOGIC_NEID AND RANNE.MODE_ID = 12 AND CELLS.OBJECTTYPEID = 'NRCell'
                 LEFT JOIN T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SUBSCRIBE SPIRIT
                           ON RANNE.NE_ID = SPIRIT.NE_ID AND RANNE.PRIMARYOSSID = SPIRIT.OSS_ID", "newString": "        SELECT distinct RANNE.NE_ID     as neId,
                       CELLS.NODEBID AS gNodeBId,
                       CELLS.CELLID   AS cellId,
                       CASE
                           WHEN RANNE.SUBSCRIBESTATUS != 1 THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.nosubscribe'
                           WHEN RANNE.NE_ID IS NULL THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.noActive'
                           ELSE ''
                           END         AS remark
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_CELL CELL
            LEFT JOIN T_MBB_RANNE_EXT RANNE ON CELL.GNODEB_ID = RANNE.LOGIC_NEID
            LEFT JOIN T_DTHR_CELL CELLS ON CELLS.NODEBID = RANNE.LOGIC_NEID AND RANNE.MODE_ID = 12 AND CELLS.OBJECTTYPEID = 'NRCell'
            LEFT JOIN T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SUBSCRIBE SPIRIT
                      ON RANNE.NE_ID = SPIRIT.NE_ID AND RANNE.PRIMARYOSSID = SPIRIT.OSS_ID
        where CELL.SCENE_ID = #{sceneId}"}

{"content": "<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.mapper.CapacityDBMapper">
    <insert id="insertVenueResults">
        INSERT INTO T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT (SCENE_ID,
                                                            PACKAGE_ID,
                                                            DATE_KEY,
                                                            BLOCK_NAME,
                                                            RESULT,
                                                            RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL,
                                                            ABNORMAL_CELL,
                                                            DEACTIVE_CELL)
        VALUES (#{result.sceneId},
                #{result.packageId},
                #{dateKey},
                #{result.blockName},
                #{result.result},
                #{result.resourceShortfallCell},
                #{result.abnormalCell},
                #{result.deactiveCell})
    </insert>
    <insert id="insertSpotOrTransportResults">
        INSERT INTO T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT (SCENE_ID,
                                                       PACKAGE_ID,
                                                       DATE_KEY,
                                                       RESULT,
                                                       REMARK,
                                                       DEACTIVE_CELL)
        VALUES (#{result.sceneId},
                #{result.packageId},
                #{dateKey},
                #{result.result},
                #{result.remark},
                #{result.deactiveCell})
    </insert>

    <!-- 更新场景预估任务状态 -->
    <update id="updatePredictTaskStatus">
        UPDATE T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        SET PREDICT_SWITCH = #{status}
        WHERE CITY_CODE = #{civicAddress.a3}
          and SCENE_CODE = #{civicAddress.loc}
          and SCENE_TYPE =
              CASE #{civicAddress.plc}
                  WHEN 'CG' THEN 0
                  WHEN 'JTSN' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'JQ' THEN 2
                  ELSE -1
                END
    </update>
    <delete id="deleteRegionBlockResults">
        BEGIN
        DELETE FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        WHERE SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>;
        DELETE FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
        WHERE SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>;
        END;
    </delete>

    <select id="getLatestRegionPeriodBySceneId" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        <if test="sceneIds != null">
            WHERE SCENE_ID IN
            <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                #{sceneId}
            </foreach>
        </if>
    </select>

    <!-- 查询区域结果 -->
    <select id="getRegionResults" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT
            RESULT.sceneId,
            SCENE.SCENE_TYPE AS sceneType,
            SCENE.SCENE_CODE AS sceneCode,
            SCENE.CITY_CODE AS cityCode,
            RESULT.blockName,
            RESULT.packageId,
            PACKAGE.PACKAGE_CODE AS packageCode,
            RESULT.dateKey,
            RESULT.result,
            RESULT.remark,
            RESULT.resourceShortfallCell,
            RESULT.abnormalCell,
            RESULT.deactiveCell
        FROM
        (SELECT
            SCENE_ID as sceneId,
            PACKAGE_ID AS packageId,
            '' as blockName,
            DATE_KEY as dateKey,
            RESULT as result,
            REMARK as remark,
            0 AS resourceShortfallCell,
            0 AS abnormalCell,
            DEACTIVE_CELL AS deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT RESULT
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID as sceneId,
            PACKAGE_ID AS packageId,
            BLOCK_NAME as blockName,
            DATE_KEY as dateKey,
            RESULT as result,
            0 as remark,
            RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL as resourceShortfallCell,
            ABNORMAL_CELL as abnormalCell,
            DEACTIVE_CELL AS deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT) RESULT
        INNER JOIN T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE ON RESULT.sceneId = SCENE.SCENE_ID
        INNER JOIN T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_PACKAGE PACKAGE ON RESULT.packageId = PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID
        WHERE (SCENE.CITY_CODE,
               CASE SCENE.SCENE_TYPE
                WHEN 0 THEN 'CG'
                WHEN 1 THEN 'JTSN'
                WHEN 2 THEN 'JQ'
                END,
               SCENE.SCENE_CODE) in
        <foreach collection="civicAddresses" item="civicAddress" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            (#{civicAddress.a3}, #{civicAddress.plc}, #{civicAddress.loc})
        </foreach>
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfos"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
        SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
        SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
        SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
        RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
        CITY_CODE as cityCode,
        PREDICT_SWITCH as predictSwitch,
        DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        <if test="sceneIds != null">
            WHERE SCENE_ID IN
            <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                #{sceneId}
            </foreach>
        </if>
    </select>
    <select id="getAllRegionResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT SCENE_ID      AS sceneId,
               PACKAGE_ID    AS packageId,
               DATE_KEY      as dateKey,
               RESULT        as result,
               REMARK        as remark,
               DEACTIVE_CELL as deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        WHERE DATE_KEY = #{regionDateKey}
    </select>
    <select id="getAllBlockResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT SCENE_ID                as sceneId,
               PACKAGE_ID              as packageId,
               DATE_KEY                as dateKey,
               BLOCK_NAME              as blockName,
               RESULT                  as result,
               RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL as resourceShortfallCell,
               ABNORMAL_CELL           as abnormalCell,
               DEACTIVE_CELL           as deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
        WHERE DATE_KEY = #{blockDateKey}
    </select>
    <select id="getRegionMaxDateKey" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
    </select>
    <select id="getBlockMaxDateKey" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfo" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
            SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
            SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
            RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
            CITY_CODE as cityCode,
            DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        WHERE CITY_CODE = #{civicAddress.a3}
          AND SCENE_CODE = #{civicAddress.loc}
          AND SCENE_TYPE =
              CASE #{civicAddress.plc}
                  WHEN 'CG' THEN 0
                  WHEN 'JTSN' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'JQ' THEN 2
                  ELSE -1
                END
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfosByCivicAddresses" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
            SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
            SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
            RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
            CITY_CODE as cityCode,
            DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE
        WHERE (SCENE.CITY_CODE, CASE SCENE.SCENE_TYPE
        WHEN 0 THEN 'CG'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'JTSN'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'JQ'
        END,
        SCENE.SCENE_CODE) in
        <foreach collection="civicAddresses" item="civicAddress" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            (#{civicAddress.a3}, #{civicAddress.plc}, #{civicAddress.loc})
        </foreach>
    </select>
    <select id="getPackageInfos"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.venuealloc.impl.bean.PackageInfo">
        SELECT PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID           AS packageId,
               PACKAGE.PACKAGE_NAME         AS packageName,
               PACKAGE.PACKAGE_CODE         AS packageCode,
               PACKAGE.UL_TARGET_THROUGHPUT AS ulGuaranteedRate,
               PACKAGE.DL_TARGET_THROUGHPUT AS dlGuaranteedRate,
               SCENE.UL_RB_WEIGHT AS ulRbWeight,
               SCENE.DL_RB_WEIGHT AS dlRbWeight,
               PACKAGE.DURATION_HOURS       AS durationHours,
               PACKAGE.QCI                  AS qci
        FROM T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_PACKAGE PACKAGE
                 INNER JOIN T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_PACKAGE SCENE
                            ON PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID = SCENE.PACKAGE_ID AND SCENE.SCENE_ID = #{sceneId}
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneCells"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.AllocResult">
        SELECT distinct RANNE.NE_ID     as neId,
               CELLS.NODEBID AS gNodeBId,
               CELLS.CELLID   AS cellId,
               CASE
                   WHEN RANNE.SUBSCRIBESTATUS != 1 THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.nosubscribe'
                   WHEN RANNE.NE_ID IS NULL THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.noActive'
                   ELSE ''
                   END         AS remark
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_CELL CELL
            LEFT JOIN T_MBB_RANNE_EXT RANNE ON CELL.GNODEB_ID = RANNE.LOGIC_NEID
                 LEFT JOIN T_DTHR_CELL CELLS ON CELLS.NODEBID = RANNE.LOGIC_NEID AND RANNE.MODE_ID = 12 AND CELLS.OBJECTTYPEID = 'NRCell'
                 LEFT JOIN T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SUBSCRIBE SPIRIT
                           ON RANNE.NE_ID = SPIRIT.NE_ID AND RANNE.PRIMARYOSSID = SPIRIT.OSS_ID
        where CELL.SCENE_ID = #{sceneId}
    </select>
    <select id="getVenueHistResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.AllocResult">
        SELECT #{sceneId}                as sceneId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.NE_ID        as gNodeBId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.CELL_ID      as cellId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID   as packageId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.ALLOC_RESULT as result,
               ALLOC_RESULT.REMARK       as remark
        FROM T_MBB_VENUE_ALLOC_RESULT ALLOC_RESULT
                 INNER JOIN T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_TASK_PACKAGE TASK_PACKAGE
                            ON ALLOC_RESULT.TASK_ID = TASK_PACKAGE.TASK_ID AND
                               ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID = TASK_PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID
        WHERE ALLOC_RESULT.TASK_ID =
              (SELECT ALLOC_TASK_ID FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_TASK WHERE SCENE_ID = #{sceneId} order by TASK_ID DESC LIMIT 1
            )
        ORDER BY ALLOC_RESULT.NE_ID, ALLOC_RESULT.CELL_ID, ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID
    </select>
</mapper>

{"content": "<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.mapper.CapacityDBMapper">
    <insert id="insertVenueResults">
        INSERT INTO T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT (SCENE_ID,
                                                            PACKAGE_ID,
                                                            DATE_KEY,
                                                            BLOCK_NAME,
                                                            RESULT,
                                                            RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL,
                                                            ABNORMAL_CELL,
                                                            DEACTIVE_CELL)
        VALUES (#{result.sceneId},
                #{result.packageId},
                #{dateKey},
                #{result.blockName},
                #{result.result},
                #{result.resourceShortfallCell},
                #{result.abnormalCell},
                #{result.deactiveCell})
    </insert>
    <insert id="insertSpotOrTransportResults">
        INSERT INTO T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT (SCENE_ID,
                                                       PACKAGE_ID,
                                                       DATE_KEY,
                                                       RESULT,
                                                       REMARK,
                                                       DEACTIVE_CELL)
        VALUES (#{result.sceneId},
                #{result.packageId},
                #{dateKey},
                #{result.result},
                #{result.remark},
                #{result.deactiveCell})
    </insert>

    <!-- 更新场景预估任务状态 -->
    <update id="updatePredictTaskStatus">
        UPDATE T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        SET PREDICT_SWITCH = #{status}
        WHERE CITY_CODE = #{civicAddress.a3}
          and SCENE_CODE = #{civicAddress.loc}
          and SCENE_TYPE =
              CASE #{civicAddress.plc}
                  WHEN 'CG' THEN 0
                  WHEN 'JTSN' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'JQ' THEN 2
                  ELSE -1
                END
    </update>
    <delete id="deleteRegionBlockResults">
        BEGIN
        DELETE FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        WHERE SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>;
        DELETE FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
        WHERE SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>;
        END;
    </delete>

    <select id="getLatestRegionPeriodBySceneId" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        <if test="sceneIds != null">
            WHERE SCENE_ID IN
            <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                #{sceneId}
            </foreach>
        </if>
    </select>

    <!-- 查询区域结果 -->
    <select id="getRegionResults" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT
            RESULT.sceneId,
            SCENE.SCENE_TYPE AS sceneType,
            SCENE.SCENE_CODE AS sceneCode,
            SCENE.CITY_CODE AS cityCode,
            RESULT.blockName,
            RESULT.packageId,
            PACKAGE.PACKAGE_CODE AS packageCode,
            RESULT.dateKey,
            RESULT.result,
            RESULT.remark,
            RESULT.resourceShortfallCell,
            RESULT.abnormalCell,
            RESULT.deactiveCell
        FROM
        (SELECT
            SCENE_ID as sceneId,
            PACKAGE_ID AS packageId,
            '' as blockName,
            DATE_KEY as dateKey,
            RESULT as result,
            REMARK as remark,
            0 AS resourceShortfallCell,
            0 AS abnormalCell,
            DEACTIVE_CELL AS deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT RESULT
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID as sceneId,
            PACKAGE_ID AS packageId,
            BLOCK_NAME as blockName,
            DATE_KEY as dateKey,
            RESULT as result,
            0 as remark,
            RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL as resourceShortfallCell,
            ABNORMAL_CELL as abnormalCell,
            DEACTIVE_CELL AS deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT) RESULT
        INNER JOIN T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE ON RESULT.sceneId = SCENE.SCENE_ID
        INNER JOIN T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_PACKAGE PACKAGE ON RESULT.packageId = PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID
        WHERE (SCENE.CITY_CODE,
               CASE SCENE.SCENE_TYPE
                WHEN 0 THEN 'CG'
                WHEN 1 THEN 'JTSN'
                WHEN 2 THEN 'JQ'
                END,
               SCENE.SCENE_CODE) in
        <foreach collection="civicAddresses" item="civicAddress" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            (#{civicAddress.a3}, #{civicAddress.plc}, #{civicAddress.loc})
        </foreach>
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfos"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
        SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
        SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
        SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
        RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
        CITY_CODE as cityCode,
        PREDICT_SWITCH as predictSwitch,
        DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        <if test="sceneIds != null">
            WHERE SCENE_ID IN
            <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                #{sceneId}
            </foreach>
        </if>
    </select>
    <select id="getAllRegionResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT SCENE_ID      AS sceneId,
               PACKAGE_ID    AS packageId,
               DATE_KEY      as dateKey,
               RESULT        as result,
               REMARK        as remark,
               DEACTIVE_CELL as deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        WHERE DATE_KEY = #{regionDateKey}
    </select>
    <select id="getAllBlockResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT SCENE_ID                as sceneId,
               PACKAGE_ID              as packageId,
               DATE_KEY                as dateKey,
               BLOCK_NAME              as blockName,
               RESULT                  as result,
               RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL as resourceShortfallCell,
               ABNORMAL_CELL           as abnormalCell,
               DEACTIVE_CELL           as deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
        WHERE DATE_KEY = #{blockDateKey}
    </select>
    <select id="getRegionMaxDateKey" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
    </select>
    <select id="getBlockMaxDateKey" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfo" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
            SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
            SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
            RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
            CITY_CODE as cityCode,
            DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        WHERE CITY_CODE = #{civicAddress.a3}
          AND SCENE_CODE = #{civicAddress.loc}
          AND SCENE_TYPE =
              CASE #{civicAddress.plc}
                  WHEN 'CG' THEN 0
                  WHEN 'JTSN' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'JQ' THEN 2
                  ELSE -1
                END
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfosByCivicAddresses" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
            SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
            SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
            RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
            CITY_CODE as cityCode,
            DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE
        WHERE (SCENE.CITY_CODE, CASE SCENE.SCENE_TYPE
        WHEN 0 THEN 'CG'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'JTSN'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'JQ'
        END,
        SCENE.SCENE_CODE) in
        <foreach collection="civicAddresses" item="civicAddress" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            (#{civicAddress.a3}, #{civicAddress.plc}, #{civicAddress.loc})
        </foreach>
    </select>
    <select id="getPackageInfos"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.venuealloc.impl.bean.PackageInfo">
        SELECT PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID           AS packageId,
               PACKAGE.PACKAGE_NAME         AS packageName,
               PACKAGE.PACKAGE_CODE         AS packageCode,
               PACKAGE.UL_TARGET_THROUGHPUT AS ulGuaranteedRate,
               PACKAGE.DL_TARGET_THROUGHPUT AS dlGuaranteedRate,
               SCENE.UL_RB_WEIGHT AS ulRbWeight,
               SCENE.DL_RB_WEIGHT AS dlRbWeight,
               PACKAGE.DURATION_HOURS       AS durationHours,
               PACKAGE.QCI                  AS qci
        FROM T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_PACKAGE PACKAGE
                 INNER JOIN T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_PACKAGE SCENE
                            ON PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID = SCENE.PACKAGE_ID AND SCENE.SCENE_ID = #{sceneId}
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneCells"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.AllocResult">
        SELECT distinct RANNE.NE_ID     as neId,
               CELLS.NODEBID AS gNodeBId,
               CELLS.CELLID   AS cellId,
               CASE
                   WHEN RANNE.SUBSCRIBESTATUS != 1 THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.nosubscribe'
                   WHEN RANNE.NE_ID IS NULL THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.noActive'
                   ELSE ''
                   END         AS remark
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_CELL CELL
            LEFT JOIN T_MBB_RANNE_EXT RANNE ON CELL.GNODEB_ID = RANNE.LOGIC_NEID
                 LEFT JOIN T_DTHR_CELL CELLS ON CELLS.NODEBID = RANNE.LOGIC_NEID AND RANNE.MODE_ID = 12 AND CELLS.OBJECTTYPEID = 'NRCell'
                 LEFT JOIN T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SUBSCRIBE SPIRIT
                           ON RANNE.NE_ID = SPIRIT.NE_ID AND RANNE.PRIMARYOSSID = SPIRIT.OSS_ID
        where CELL.SCENE_ID = #{sceneId}
    </select>
    <select id="getVenueHistResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.AllocResult">
        SELECT #{sceneId}                as sceneId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.NE_ID        as gNodeBId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.CELL_ID      as cellId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID   as packageId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.ALLOC_RESULT as result,
               ALLOC_RESULT.REMARK       as remark
        FROM T_MBB_VENUE_ALLOC_RESULT ALLOC_RESULT
                 INNER JOIN T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_TASK_PACKAGE TASK_PACKAGE
                            ON ALLOC_RESULT.TASK_ID = TASK_PACKAGE.TASK_ID AND
                               ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID = TASK_PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID
        WHERE ALLOC_RESULT.TASK_ID =
              (SELECT ALLOC_TASK_ID FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_TASK WHERE SCENE_ID = #{sceneId} order by TASK_ID DESC LIMIT 1
            )
        ORDER BY ALLOC_RESULT.NE_ID, ALLOC_RESULT.CELL_ID, ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID
    </select>
</mapper>

{"content": "<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.mapper.CapacityDBMapper">
    <insert id="insertVenueResults">
        INSERT INTO T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT (SCENE_ID,
                                                            PACKAGE_ID,
                                                            DATE_KEY,
                                                            BLOCK_NAME,
                                                            RESULT,
                                                            RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL,
                                                            ABNORMAL_CELL,
                                                            DEACTIVE_CELL)
        VALUES (#{result.sceneId},
                #{result.packageId},
                #{dateKey},
                #{result.blockName},
                #{result.result},
                #{result.resourceShortfallCell},
                #{result.abnormalCell},
                #{result.deactiveCell})
    </insert>
    <insert id="insertSpotOrTransportResults">
        INSERT INTO T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT (SCENE_ID,
                                                       PACKAGE_ID,
                                                       DATE_KEY,
                                                       RESULT,
                                                       REMARK,
                                                       DEACTIVE_CELL)
        VALUES (#{result.sceneId},
                #{result.packageId},
                #{dateKey},
                #{result.result},
                #{result.remark},
                #{result.deactiveCell})
    </insert>

    <!-- 更新场景预估任务状态 -->
    <update id="updatePredictTaskStatus">
        UPDATE T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        SET PREDICT_SWITCH = #{status}
        WHERE CITY_CODE = #{civicAddress.a3}
          and SCENE_CODE = #{civicAddress.loc}
          and SCENE_TYPE =
              CASE #{civicAddress.plc}
                  WHEN 'CG' THEN 0
                  WHEN 'JTSN' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'JQ' THEN 2
                  ELSE -1
                END
    </update>
    <delete id="deleteRegionBlockResults">
        BEGIN
        DELETE FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        WHERE SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>;
        DELETE FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
        WHERE SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>;
        END;
    </delete>

    <select id="getLatestRegionPeriodBySceneId" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        <if test="sceneIds != null">
            WHERE SCENE_ID IN
            <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                #{sceneId}
            </foreach>
        </if>
    </select>

    <!-- 查询区域结果 -->
    <select id="getRegionResults" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT
            RESULT.sceneId,
            SCENE.SCENE_TYPE AS sceneType,
            SCENE.SCENE_CODE AS sceneCode,
            SCENE.CITY_CODE AS cityCode,
            RESULT.blockName,
            RESULT.packageId,
            PACKAGE.PACKAGE_CODE AS packageCode,
            RESULT.dateKey,
            RESULT.result,
            RESULT.remark,
            RESULT.resourceShortfallCell,
            RESULT.abnormalCell,
            RESULT.deactiveCell
        FROM
        (SELECT
            SCENE_ID as sceneId,
            PACKAGE_ID AS packageId,
            '' as blockName,
            DATE_KEY as dateKey,
            RESULT as result,
            REMARK as remark,
            0 AS resourceShortfallCell,
            0 AS abnormalCell,
            DEACTIVE_CELL AS deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT RESULT
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID as sceneId,
            PACKAGE_ID AS packageId,
            BLOCK_NAME as blockName,
            DATE_KEY as dateKey,
            RESULT as result,
            0 as remark,
            RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL as resourceShortfallCell,
            ABNORMAL_CELL as abnormalCell,
            DEACTIVE_CELL AS deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT) RESULT
        INNER JOIN T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE ON RESULT.sceneId = SCENE.SCENE_ID
        INNER JOIN T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_PACKAGE PACKAGE ON RESULT.packageId = PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID
        WHERE (SCENE.CITY_CODE,
               CASE SCENE.SCENE_TYPE
                WHEN 0 THEN 'CG'
                WHEN 1 THEN 'JTSN'
                WHEN 2 THEN 'JQ'
                END,
               SCENE.SCENE_CODE) in
        <foreach collection="civicAddresses" item="civicAddress" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            (#{civicAddress.a3}, #{civicAddress.plc}, #{civicAddress.loc})
        </foreach>
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfos"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
        SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
        SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
        SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
        RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
        CITY_CODE as cityCode,
        PREDICT_SWITCH as predictSwitch,
        DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        <if test="sceneIds != null">
            WHERE SCENE_ID IN
            <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                #{sceneId}
            </foreach>
        </if>
    </select>
    <select id="getAllRegionResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT SCENE_ID      AS sceneId,
               PACKAGE_ID    AS packageId,
               DATE_KEY      as dateKey,
               RESULT        as result,
               REMARK        as remark,
               DEACTIVE_CELL as deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        WHERE DATE_KEY = #{regionDateKey}
    </select>
    <select id="getAllBlockResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT SCENE_ID                as sceneId,
               PACKAGE_ID              as packageId,
               DATE_KEY                as dateKey,
               BLOCK_NAME              as blockName,
               RESULT                  as result,
               RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL as resourceShortfallCell,
               ABNORMAL_CELL           as abnormalCell,
               DEACTIVE_CELL           as deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
        WHERE DATE_KEY = #{blockDateKey}
    </select>
    <select id="getRegionMaxDateKey" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
    </select>
    <select id="getBlockMaxDateKey" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfo" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
            SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
            SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
            RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
            CITY_CODE as cityCode,
            DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        WHERE CITY_CODE = #{civicAddress.a3}
          AND SCENE_CODE = #{civicAddress.loc}
          AND SCENE_TYPE =
              CASE #{civicAddress.plc}
                  WHEN 'CG' THEN 0
                  WHEN 'JTSN' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'JQ' THEN 2
                  ELSE -1
                END
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfosByCivicAddresses" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
            SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
            SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
            RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
            CITY_CODE as cityCode,
            DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE
        WHERE (SCENE.CITY_CODE, CASE SCENE.SCENE_TYPE
        WHEN 0 THEN 'CG'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'JTSN'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'JQ'
        END,
        SCENE.SCENE_CODE) in
        <foreach collection="civicAddresses" item="civicAddress" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            (#{civicAddress.a3}, #{civicAddress.plc}, #{civicAddress.loc})
        </foreach>
    </select>
    <select id="getPackageInfos"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.venuealloc.impl.bean.PackageInfo">
        SELECT PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID           AS packageId,
               PACKAGE.PACKAGE_NAME         AS packageName,
               PACKAGE.PACKAGE_CODE         AS packageCode,
               PACKAGE.UL_TARGET_THROUGHPUT AS ulGuaranteedRate,
               PACKAGE.DL_TARGET_THROUGHPUT AS dlGuaranteedRate,
               SCENE.UL_RB_WEIGHT AS ulRbWeight,
               SCENE.DL_RB_WEIGHT AS dlRbWeight,
               PACKAGE.DURATION_HOURS       AS durationHours,
               PACKAGE.QCI                  AS qci
        FROM T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_PACKAGE PACKAGE
                 INNER JOIN T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_PACKAGE SCENE
                            ON PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID = SCENE.PACKAGE_ID AND SCENE.SCENE_ID = #{sceneId}
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneCells"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.AllocResult">
        SELECT distinct RANNE.NE_ID     as neId,
               CELLS.NODEBID AS gNodeBId,
               CELLS.CELLID   AS cellId,
               CASE
                   WHEN RANNE.SUBSCRIBESTATUS != 1 THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.nosubscribe'
                   WHEN RANNE.NE_ID IS NULL THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.noActive'
                   ELSE ''
                   END         AS remark
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_CELL CELL
            LEFT JOIN T_MBB_RANNE_EXT RANNE ON CELL.GNODEB_ID = RANNE.LOGIC_NEID
                 LEFT JOIN T_DTHR_CELL CELLS ON CELLS.NODEBID = RANNE.LOGIC_NEID AND RANNE.MODE_ID = 12 AND CELLS.OBJECTTYPEID = 'NRCell'
                 LEFT JOIN T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SUBSCRIBE SPIRIT
                           ON RANNE.NE_ID = SPIRIT.NE_ID AND RANNE.PRIMARYOSSID = SPIRIT.OSS_ID
        where CELL.SCENE_ID = #{sceneId}
    </select>
    <select id="getVenueHistResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.AllocResult">
        SELECT #{sceneId}                as sceneId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.NE_ID        as gNodeBId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.CELL_ID      as cellId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID   as packageId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.ALLOC_RESULT as result,
               ALLOC_RESULT.REMARK       as remark
        FROM T_MBB_VENUE_ALLOC_RESULT ALLOC_RESULT
                 INNER JOIN T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_TASK_PACKAGE TASK_PACKAGE
                            ON ALLOC_RESULT.TASK_ID = TASK_PACKAGE.TASK_ID AND
                               ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID = TASK_PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID
        WHERE ALLOC_RESULT.TASK_ID =
              (SELECT ALLOC_TASK_ID FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_TASK WHERE SCENE_ID = #{sceneId} order by TASK_ID DESC LIMIT 1
            )
        ORDER BY ALLOC_RESULT.NE_ID, ALLOC_RESULT.CELL_ID, ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID
    </select>
</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        (TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS)
        VALUES
        (#{templateId}, #{templateName}, #{remark}, #{version}, #{createDate}, #{creator}, #{modifyDate}, #{modifier}, #{status}, #{templateType}, #{cover}, #{catalogs})
    </insert>

    <select id="selectByTemplateId" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <update id="updateByTemplateId">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            STATUS = #{reportTemplatePO.status},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN"
        "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        (TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS)
        VALUES
        (#{templateId}, #{templateName}, #{remark}, #{version}, #{createDate}, #{creator}, #{modifyDate}, #{modifier}, #{status}, #{templateType}, #{cover}, #{catalogs})
    </insert>

    <select id="selectByTemplateId" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <update id="updateByTemplateId">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            STATUS = #{reportTemplatePO.status},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

</mapper>

        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}

            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},

    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN"
        "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        (TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS)
        VALUES
        (#{templateId}, #{templateName}, #{remark}, #{version}, #{createDate}, #{creator}, #{modifyDate}, #{modifier}, #{status}, #{templateType}, #{cover}, #{catalogs})
    </insert>

    <select id="selectByTemplateId" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT *
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <update id="updateByTemplateId">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>
</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <!-- 插入报告模板 -->
    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        (TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS)
        VALUES
        (#{templateId}, #{templateName}, #{remark}, #{version}, #{createDate}, #{creator}, #{modifyDate}, #{modifier}, #{status}, #{templateType}, #{cover}, #{catalogs})
    </insert>

    <!-- 根据模板ID查询报告模板 -->
    <select id="selectByTemplateId" parameterType="string" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <!-- 根据模板ID删除报告模板 -->
    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId" parameterType="string">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <!-- 根据模板ID更新报告模板 -->
    <update id="updateByTemplateId">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新模板状态为已发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新模板状态为未发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
            (TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS)
        VALUES
            (#{templateId}, #{templateName}, #{remark}, #{version}, #{createDate}, #{creator}, #{modifyDate}, #{modifier}, #{status}, #{templateType}, #{cover}, #{catalogs})
    </insert>

    <select id="selectByTemplateId" parameterType="java.lang.String" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId" parameterType="java.lang.String">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <update id="updateByTemplateId">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET
            TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>
</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <!-- 插入报告模板 -->
    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        (TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS)
        VALUES
        (#{templateId}, #{templateName}, #{remark}, #{version}, #{createDate}, #{creator}, #{modifyDate}, #{modifier}, #{status}, #{templateType}, #{cover}, #{catalogs})
    </insert>

    <!-- 根据模板ID查询报告模板 -->
    <select id="selectByTemplateId" parameterType="string" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <!-- 根据模板ID删除报告模板 -->
    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId" parameterType="string">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <!-- 根据模板ID更新报告模板 -->
    <update id="updateByTemplateId">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            TEMPLATE_TYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新模板发布状态为已发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新模板发布状态为未发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        (TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS)
        VALUES
        (#{templateId}, #{templateName}, #{remark}, #{version}, #{createDate}, #{creator}, #{modifyDate}, #{modifier}, #{status}, #{templateType}, #{cover}, #{catalogs})
    </insert>

    <select id="selectByTemplateId" parameterType="java.lang.String" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId" parameterType="java.lang.String">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <update id="updateByTemplateId">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        (TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS)
        VALUES (#{templateId}, #{templateName}, #{remark}, #{version}, #{createDate}, #{creator}, #{modifyDate}, #{modifier}, #{status}, #{templateType}, #{cover}, #{catalogs})
    </insert>

    <select id="selectByTemplateId" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <update id="updateByTemplateId">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            STATUS = #{reportTemplatePO.status},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>
</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
            (TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS)
        VALUES
            (#{templateId}, #{templateName}, #{remark}, #{version}, #{createDate}, #{creator}, #{modifyDate}, #{modifier}, #{status}, #{templateType}, #{cover}, #{catalogs})
    </insert>

    <select id="selectByTemplateId" parameterType="string" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT
            TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId" parameterType="string">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <update id="updateByTemplateId">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET
            TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>
</mapper>

<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        (TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS)
        VALUES (#{templateId}, #{templateName}, #{remark}, #{version}, #{createDate}, #{creator}, #{modifyDate}, #{modifier}, #{status}, #{templateType}, #{cover}, #{catalogs})
    </insert>

    <select id="selectByTemplateId" parameterType="string" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId" parameterType="string">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <update id="updateByTemplateId">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            STATUS = #{reportTemplatePO.status},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <!-- 插入报告模板 -->
    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        (TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR,
         MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS)
        VALUES
        (#{templateId}, #{templateName}, #{remark}, #{version}, #{createDate}, #{creator},
         #{modifyDate}, #{modifier}, #{status}, #{templateType}, #{cover}, #{catalogs})
    </insert>

    <!-- 按模板ID查询报告模板 -->
    <select id="selectByTemplateId" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT TEMPLATEID AS templateId, TEMPLATENAME AS templateName, REMARK AS remark,
               VERSION AS version, CREATEDATE AS createDate, CREATOR AS creator,
               MODIFYDATE AS modifyDate, MODIFIER AS modifier, STATUS AS status,
               TEMPLATETYPE AS templateType, COVER AS cover, CATALOGS AS catalogs
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <!-- 按模板ID删除报告模板 -->
    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <!-- 按模板ID更新报告模板 -->
    <update id="updateByTemplateId">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            STATUS = #{reportTemplatePO.status},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新模板状态为已发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新模板状态为未发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

</mapper>

            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},

</mapper>
